title: Marangoni swimmer-spread loop 2 (seed 501): the trait mean again rises more in the escape arm than in its identical-event twin (47.5 vs 37.5; seed 500: 45.7 vs 36.7), and the M-gate share is higher on this seed (5 of 9 vs 2 of 10, against 1/17 vs 2/17 on seed 500), but discs that grow twice as fast do not reward distance (E 7/13, twin 7/17, D gradient +0.03); drive-off rods make 0 of 9 passers under fast discs
summary: Same world as loop 1 (c45's mar 20/40/60 ladder, all founders mar 40, in-run mutation, growing sink discs one per 50 t). Seed 501: E vs identical-event twin at the loop-1 disc speed, and E, twin, no-escape C and drive-off at twice the disc growth speed. On the two slow-disc seeds the pre-registered trait mean rises in E (+5.7, +7.5) and falls in the twin (-3.3, -2.5); the passing share of dividing rods (3 own rod lengths with the rear tip advancing) is higher in E on seed 501 only, and varies more between seeds (1/17 to 5/9) than between arms. Faster discs lower the escape share and leave the selection gradient on distance per cycle near zero (+0.03 in E, -0.15 in the twin); the twin's mar-60 label drifts to 56 there, from a mutation stream that sends k1 to k2 five times for once to k0, which also lifts the drive-off arm to 45. Passers translate (rear tip 0.83-1.01 of net, growing area), and drive-off rods make no passers, so the discs do not fake the capability. With 4-20 bodies per 128^2 run single lineages decide each curve; loop 3 tries a supply only movers reach.
